note: v4 validator kept unchanged. Wrongs: linear-history insert-count versions (branching breaks), in-place AVL mutation (not persistent), full frozenset copy per version (memory gate). slow.py = unbalanced path-copying BST, caught by the validator's own 3 s insert limit. Known validator gaps (plausible wrongs that PASS): version-as-(parent,key) chain with O(n) contains (chainwalk, chainmemo), path-copied crit-bit trie (bittrie), unbalanced BST keyed by a bijective mix of the key (mixorder) -- the validator never times contains() and only inserts ascending/shuffled small ints. wrong_fullcopy (whole-tree copy) fails only by the insert-time limit (~19 s), not the memory gate, so it is not used.
